Determine the upwind slope ay in the wind direction A. This is the value @ in
figure 3.1.

Is ay greater than 0.05?

Yes: Go to step (A3)
No: Local topography for wind direction A is not significant. Take the
topography factor S, = 1 and go to step (B1).

Determine the effective height H of the crest above the foreground level of the
upwind slope in the direction of the wind. This is the value H; in figure 3.1.

Determine the horizontal distance X of the building from the crest. X is
negative with respective to wind direction A. This is equal to -X7 in figure 3.1.

Is the site located within a height 0.5H from the crest?

(i.e., is @y X; < 0.5H?)

Yes: Go to step (A6)

Yes: Topography is “hill-and-ridge” with respect to wind direction A.
No: Topography is “cliff-and-escarpment” with respect to wind direction A.
